generate_dummy_code_pybind11: generate dummy C++ pybind11 binding code with a configurable number of classes and methods
generate_dummy_code_boost: generate dummy C++ boost python binding code with a configurable number of classes and methods
benchmark_pybind11_vs_boost: run the benchmark script to compare pybind11 and boost python compilation times and output sizes
generate_test_cpp: generate a test.cpp file with random class declarations and method signatures for benchmarking
measure_compilation_size: measure the compilation time and shared object file size for generated C++ binding code
